perItemFindings.label: lem:exact-forward-doob
perItemFindings.one_line: FiniteDesign.Var_prod_linear_comb and Cov_prod_apply_of_ne apply only to fixed single-coordinate terms c i * g i (w i); the reveal increments and F_n contain prefix products and depend on multiple coordinates, so they cannot establish their orthogonality or E[Q_n] = Var(F_n).

verbatim_critique: Re-plan lem:exact-forward-doob to drop this ProductVariance reuse for the quadratic-variation identity. Derive it from the planned prefixCondE tower/conditional-centering orthogonality, or introduce a correctly shaped local martingale-orthogonality lemma. E_htEffect remains sound for the separate mean bridge.
